briefs.title: Your graduation project: four different dates
briefs.summary: Poster upload, advisor review, panel setup and the presentation each have their own date. The later presentation does not extend the poster deadline.
steps: The subsidised poster upload closed on 9 November at 23:59. Late posters must be printed at your own expense.
Get your advisor’s review of thesis and poster drafts by 16 November. No exact cutoff time is stated.
At least one person per laboratory helps set up panels on 19 November at 15:00; a class at that time is an exception.
Arrive before 10:00 for the 20 November presentation. Judging runs 10:00–16:00, with attendance checks at 10:30, 12:00 and 15:30.
notes: For a conflicting class, bring a printed mySNU timetable. Staff verify it and issue the absence form on the day.
One A1 portrait poster PDF per team; use the official notice’s form.
